tasks.title: Fix runPreflightChecks notes extraction (section-split regex)
definition_of_done:
The broken one-shot regex block in reference-impl/lib/release-preflight.ts (around lines 156–168) is replaced with the section-split approach: changelog.split(/
(?=## )/), versionRegex.test(s) per section, match.replace(/^[^
]*
/, '').trim()

release-preflight.test.ts test count advances from 10 to 13: existing case 1 additionally asserts notes.length > 0 and that notes contains the version-header body text; new case 11 asserts notes contains '### Added' and '- foo' and does NOT contain 0.6.5 section content; new case 12 asserts notes are correctly extracted when the target version is the last section in the CHANGELOG with no trailing ## header
All 13 release-preflight tests pass (vitest run) with zero failures
No changes made outside reference-impl/lib/release-preflight.ts and reference-impl/tests/release-preflight.test.ts
acceptance_criteria: cloverleaf-cli release-preflight <repoRoot> --json returns a non-empty notes field for the current package.json::version when the corresponding ## <version> — DATE section exists in CHANGELOG.md
The notes string equals the section body (everything after the version header line up to the next ## header or EOF), trimmed of leading/trailing whitespace

Case 11: CHANGELOG containing ## 0.6.6 — DATE

### Added

- foo

## 0.6.5 — ... with version=0.6.6 returns notes that contains '### Added' and '- foo' and does not contain any 0.6.5 content
Case 12: when the target version is the last section in the CHANGELOG (no subsequent ## header), notes is still correctly extracted and contains the section content with no trailing whitespace cruft
Updated case 1 (existing happy-path): notes.length > 0 and the captured notes contain the body of the version header section
vitest run on reference-impl reports 13 passing tests for the release-preflight suite, 0 failing

tasks.title: Walker CWD hardening — replace bare git calls in cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md
definition_of_done: All bare git invocations in walker bash blocks of reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md are replaced with git -C <repo_root> equivalents; specifically the six step-5e calls (git checkout main, git diff --name-only, git merge --no-ff, git add .cloverleaf/, git commit -m, git rev-parse HEAD) plus any other bare git invocations found by grepping ^\s*git\s+(?!-C\b)
Grep of SKILL.md for bare git invocations outside the step-0 read-only allowlist (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref, git status) returns zero matches after the fix

A regression guard test is added to reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts that scans cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md line-by-line and asserts no bare git invocations exist outside the allowed read-only step-0 pre-flight commands
All existing plus the new skills.test.ts test pass (vitest run) with zero failures
No changes made outside reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md and reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts
acceptance_criteria: Every state-mutating git call in walker bash blocks of SKILL.md uses git -C <repo_root> so git resolves paths against the repo root regardless of shell pwd

The six specific step-5e substitutions are present: git -C <repo_root> checkout main, git -C <repo_root> diff --name-only main..cloverleaf/<TASK-ID>, git -C <repo_root> merge --no-ff cloverleaf/<TASK-ID> -m '...', git -C <repo_root> add .cloverleaf/, git -C <repo_root> commit -m '...', git -C <repo_root> rev-parse HEAD
The regression guard test in skills.test.ts fails if any future bare git invocation (not in the allowlist) is introduced into SKILL.md — confirming the guard is live and correctly enforced
Allowlist in the test covers exactly: git rev-parse --abbrev-ref (step-0 pre-flight) and git status (step-0 pre-flight); all other git lines must use -C <repo_root>
vitest run on reference-impl reports the new regression guard test passing, 0 failing
